title: The Shirt and the Caftan
summary: When Nasruddin wore his rough woolen caftan, people called him an ignorant peasant. When he wore his green silk robe, they bowed and kissed his hem....
full_text:
When Nasruddin wore his rough woolen caftan, people called him an ignorant peasant. When he wore his green silk robe, they bowed and kissed his hem.

Nasruddin smiled: "How wonderful! Yesterday I was a fool, and today I am a philosopher, all because of two yards of green silk!"
moral: Outward robes change with fashion, but the honest man inside remains constant.
